rule: Every field has a visible, persistent label tied to the control.
check: every input/select/textarea has a <label for> or aria-labelledby; 0 unlabeled controls
do: Put the label above the field and link it with for/id.
dont: Rely on placeholder text as the only label; it vanishes on typing.

hook.message: placeholder present but no label in this file

rule: Use the input type and inputmode that match the data so mobile keyboards fit it.
check: email/tel/url/number-like fields use type or inputmode, not plain text
do: type=email, type=tel, inputmode=numeric for codes.
dont: type=number for card numbers, ZIPs or phone numbers (it adds spinners and drops leading zeros).

rule: Turn on browser and OS autofill with correct autocomplete tokens.
check: name/email/tel/address/cc fields carry a valid autocomplete token
do: autocomplete="email", "given-name", "street-address", "cc-number".
dont: autocomplete="off" on personal-data fields.

rule: Validate on blur or submit, not on every keystroke before the user finishes.
check: no error shown while the field has focus and has never been blurred
do: Show the error after the first blur, then re-validate live so it clears as soon as it is fixed.
dont: Flash 'invalid email' after the first character.

rule: Errors sit next to the field, say what went wrong and how to fix it, and are announced.
check: error text linked via aria-describedby and field has aria-invalid=true
do: 'Enter a date after 01/01/2020' under the field, linked with aria-describedby.
dont: A red border alone, or one 'Form has errors' banner with no field pointer.
good: Enter a date after 2020.

rule: On a failed submit, move focus to the first invalid field or to an error summary that links to each field.
check: after failed submit, document.activeElement is the summary or first invalid field
do: Summary at the top with anchor links; focus it on submit.
dont: Leave focus on the submit button with errors scrolled out of view.

rule: Mark optional fields rather than required ones when most fields are required, and never use colour alone.
check: required state exposed with the required attribute, not only an asterisk colour
do: Use the required attribute; add '(optional)' text to the few optional fields.
dont: A red asterisk with no text alternative and no required attribute.

rule: Keep forms to one column so the reading path is a straight line.
check: multi-column only for tightly related short pairs (city/postcode, expiry/CVC)
do: Stack fields; pair only short related fields.
dont: Zig-zag two-column layouts that hide fields from skimmers.

rule: Disable the submit button only while a request is in flight, never as the way to signal invalid input.
check: submit is enabled while idle; aria-busy or a spinner while pending
do: Let the user press submit and then explain what is missing.
dont: A greyed-out submit with no hint about why.

rule: Prevent double submits and make retries safe.
check: second click within the pending window sends no second request
do: Set a pending state on first submit; send an idempotency key for payments.
dont: Let a slow network turn one click into two orders.

rule: Allow paste in every field, including passwords and verification codes.
check: no onpaste preventDefault in source
do: Accept pasted one-time codes and split them across segmented inputs.
dont: Block paste 'for security' on passwords or emails.

rule: Offer a show-password toggle and support password managers.
check: password field has a toggle button with aria-pressed and autocomplete set
do: A 'Show' button with aria-pressed next to the field.
dont: Two password fields with no reveal option.

rule: Every interactive element has distinct default, hover, focus-visible, active, disabled and loading looks.
check: focus-visible style differs from default; disabled has visual + disabled attr
do: Define all states in the component, not ad hoc.
dont: Only style :hover, leaving keyboard users with no feedback.

rule: Focus indicator is visible and contrasts at least 3:1 with the surrounding colours.
check: focus ring contrast >= 3:1 against adjacent colours and >= 2 CSS px thick
do: outline:2px solid with offset, in a token colour checked against both themes.
dont: outline:none with no replacement.

rule: Focused elements are never fully hidden by sticky headers, cookie bars or chat widgets.
check: focused element's box is not fully covered by a fixed/sticky element (WCAG 2.4.11)
do: scroll-padding-top equal to the sticky header height.
dont: Tab into links that sit underneath a fixed header.

rule: Hover is an enhancement, never the only way to reveal actions or information.
check: every hover-revealed control is also reachable on focus and on touch
do: Show row actions on hover and on :focus-within; always show them on touch (@media (hover:none)).
dont: Delete buttons that exist only on mouse hover.

rule: Disabled controls explain why when the reason is not obvious.
check: disabled control has adjacent helper text or aria-describedby
do: 'Add a payment method to continue' next to a disabled button.
dont: Silently disabled buttons.
good: Add a card first.

rule: State changes are not conveyed by colour alone.
check: selected/error/success states carry an icon, text or shape change as well as colour
do: Error = red + icon + message. Selected tab = colour + underline.
dont: A green vs red dot as the only status signal.

rule: Toggles reflect their state to assistive tech.
check: toggle buttons expose aria-pressed or role=switch with aria-checked
do: button[aria-pressed] for toggles; role=switch for on/off settings.
dont: A div that swaps a CSS class with no ARIA state.

rule: Press feedback appears within 100 ms of input.
check: visual response to pointerdown/click <= 100 ms; INP <= 200 ms
do: Use :active styles and optimistic UI; defer heavy work after paint.
dont: Run the expensive handler before any visual change.

rule: Selected and current items use aria-current or aria-selected, not only styling.
check: current nav link has aria-current=page
do: <a aria-current="page"> for the current page.
dont: A bold 'active' class only.

rule: Read-only and disabled are different: read-only stays focusable and copyable.
check: read-only values use readonly, not disabled
do: readonly for values the user may copy; disabled for unavailable actions.
dont: disabled on an account ID the user needs to copy.

rule: Primary navigation has 7 or fewer top-level items and a clear current location.
check: top-level nav items <= 7; current item marked
do: Group the rest into a 'More' menu or secondary nav.
dont: Twelve top-level links that wrap to two rows.

rule: Wrap navigation in a labelled nav landmark; label each one when there are several.
check: each <nav> has a unique aria-label when more than one exists
do: nav aria-label="Main" and nav aria-label="Footer".
dont: Two unlabelled navs or a div of links.

rule: Provide a skip link to the main content as the first focusable element.
check: first Tab press reveals a working 'Skip to content' link
do: Visually hidden until focused; targets <main id>.
dont: No skip link on pages with long headers.

rule: The mobile menu toggle is a real button that reports its state and closes with Escape.
check: toggle has aria-expanded that flips; Escape closes and returns focus to the toggle
do: button[aria-expanded][aria-controls]; trap focus only if it is modal.
dont: A hamburger div that cannot be reached by keyboard.

rule: Use bottom tab bars for 3 to 5 top destinations in mobile apps.
check: 3-5 tabs; each has icon + text label
do: Icon plus short label; keep tabs persistent across the section.
dont: Icon-only tabs or more than 5 tabs.

rule: Back always goes back: browser and system back restore the previous view, scroll and filters.
check: after back navigation, previous scroll position and filters are restored
do: Store filter state in the URL; let the router restore scroll.
dont: Open details in client state so Back leaves the app.

rule: Links look like links and buttons look like buttons; links navigate, buttons act.
check: no <a> without href used as a button; no button used for page navigation
do: <a href> for navigation, <button> for actions.
dont: href="#" or javascript: to trigger actions.

rule: Breadcrumbs show hierarchy on deep sites, not history.
check: breadcrumb nav has aria-label and current item aria-current
do: Use for 3+ levels of hierarchy.
dont: Breadcrumbs on a two-page site.

rule: Anchor jumps account for sticky headers and respect reduced motion.
check: scroll-margin-top set on anchor targets; smooth scroll only without reduced-motion
do: scroll-margin-top on headings; smooth scrolling inside a no-preference media query.
dont: Global smooth scroll that ignores reduced-motion.

hook.message: smooth scroll without a reduced-motion guard

rule: Never open new tabs or windows without warning.
check: links with target=_blank state it in text or an icon with a label
do: Add '(opens in new tab)' visually or in a visually-hidden span.
dont: Open every external link in a new tab silently.
good: Report (opens in new tab)

rule: Positive tabindex is never used; DOM order is the focus order.
check: no tabindex > 0 in source
do: Fix the DOM order; use tabindex=0 or -1 only.
dont: tabindex="3" to patch focus order.

rule: Every user action gets visible feedback: success, failure or progress.
check: each mutating action shows a result within 1 s or a progress indicator
do: Inline 'Saved' text or a toast after saving.
dont: A save button that silently does nothing visible.

rule: Status messages are announced without moving focus.
check: toasts and inline status use role=status or aria-live=polite
do: A persistent <div role="status"> that receives text updates.
dont: Injecting a new live region at the same moment as its text (often not announced).

rule: Toasts stay at least 5 s, pause on hover and focus, and never carry the only copy of an action.
check: auto-dismiss >= 5000 ms; pausable; actions also available elsewhere
do: Undo in the toast and in the item's menu.
dont: A 2-second toast with the only Undo button.

rule: Prefer undo over confirmation for reversible actions.
check: reversible deletes offer undo for >= 5 s instead of a confirm dialog
do: Archive immediately with an Undo toast.
dont: 'Are you sure?' on every reversible action.

rule: Destructive, irreversible actions need explicit confirmation naming the object.
check: confirm dialog names the item and uses a specific verb button
do: 'Delete project “Atlas”? This removes 42 files.' [Delete project]
dont: 'Are you sure?' [OK] [Cancel].

rule: Optimistic updates roll back visibly when the server rejects them.
check: on failure the item reverts and an error explains it
do: Show the change at once, revert with a message on error.
dont: Keep the optimistic state after a failed request.
good: try { await save() } catch { revert(); notify("Couldn't save. Retry?") }

rule: Use haptics sparingly and only for meaningful confirmations.
check: haptic feedback only on success/error/selection changes, never on scroll
do: A light impact on a completed payment.
dont: Vibration on every tap.

rule: Feedback appears near where the user is looking.
check: inline feedback within the same viewport region as the trigger
do: Show 'Copied' next to the copy button.
dont: A toast in the far corner for a tiny inline action.

rule: System alerts, alert() and confirm() are not used for product feedback.
check: no window.alert/confirm in UI code
do: Use the product's own dialog and toast components.
dont: Native alert boxes that block the thread and cannot be styled.

hook.message: native alert/confirm used for UI feedback

rule: Progress for tasks over 4 s shows how far along it is.
check: determinate progress (percent or steps) for operations > 4 s
do: 'Uploading 3 of 8 files — 42%'.
dont: An indefinite spinner for a two-minute upload.

rule: Use skeletons that match the final layout for content loads over 300 ms.
check: skeleton dimensions within 10% of the loaded content; CLS <= 0.1
do: Skeleton rows with the same heights as real rows.
dont: A centred spinner that is replaced by a tall list, shifting everything.

rule: Delay loading indicators by about 300 ms to avoid flicker on fast responses.
check: no spinner rendered for responses < 300 ms
do: Start the spinner after a short timeout; keep it at least 500 ms once shown.
dont: Flash a spinner for 40 ms.

rule: Empty states explain what belongs here and offer the next action.
check: empty view has a sentence and a primary action
do: 'No invoices yet. Create your first invoice.' [Create invoice]
dont: A blank table with headers only.

rule: Distinguish 'nothing here yet', 'no results for this filter' and 'failed to load'.
check: three different messages and actions for the three states
do: No results: show the active filters and a 'Clear filters' button.
dont: One 'Nothing found' message for errors too.
good: if (error) Retry; else if (filtered) ClearFilters; else CreateFirst

rule: Error messages say what happened, why if known, and what to do next, in plain words.
check: no raw codes or stack traces shown; every error offers a next step
do: 'We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.' [Retry]

rule: Failed regions fail locally: one broken widget never blanks the whole page.
check: error boundary per independent region
do: Wrap each panel in its own error boundary with a retry.
dont: One top-level boundary that replaces the app with an error.

rule: Offline state is detected and explained; queued work is shown.
check: offline banner within 2 s of losing connection; pending changes listed
do: Show 'You're offline. 3 changes will sync.'
dont: Fail each request separately with generic errors.

rule: Lists load more with a button or paginate; infinite scroll keeps the footer reachable.
check: footer reachable by keyboard and scroll; 'Load more' button available
do: A 'Load more' button plus URL page state.
dont: Infinite scroll that makes the footer unreachable.

rule: 404 and 500 pages keep the site navigation and offer search or a way home.
check: error pages render the global nav and at least one recovery link
do: Header, a short explanation, search and popular links.
dont: A bare 'Not found' string.

rule: Timeouts are handled: requests over 10 s show a message and a cancel or retry.
check: long requests time out with a visible message; user can cancel
do: AbortController with a 10-15 s timeout and a retry button.
dont: A spinner that spins forever.

rule: Loading never hides content that was already on screen.
check: refreshing keeps stale data visible with a subtle busy indicator
do: Show cached data with a small 'Updating…' label.
dont: Blank the list on every refetch.

rule: Modal dialogs trap focus, close on Escape and return focus to the trigger.
check: Tab cycles inside; Esc closes; focus returns to opener
do: Use the native <dialog> with showModal() or a tested library.
dont: A div overlay that lets Tab escape into the page behind.

rule: Dialogs have an accessible name and the background is inert.
check: role=dialog/aria-modal or <dialog>; aria-labelledby set; background inert
do: aria-labelledby pointing at the dialog title; inert on the page behind.
dont: Unnamed dialogs; screen reader can wander behind.

rule: Use a modal only when the task must be finished or dismissed before continuing.
check: non-blocking info uses inline UI, drawers or toasts instead
do: Inline expansion for details; modal for 'Discard changes?'.
dont: Modals for newsletters on first page view.

rule: Lock background scroll while a modal is open without layout shift.
check: no scroll chaining; scrollbar gutter stable when locking
do: overflow:hidden plus scrollbar-gutter:stable; overscroll-behavior:contain on the dialog.
dont: Locking scroll so the page jumps sideways by the scrollbar width.

rule: Every overlay has a visible close control of at least 24×24 CSS px with a label.
check: close button >= 24x24 CSS px (44pt on touch) with accessible name
do: <button aria-label="Close">×</button> sized 44px on touch.
dont: A tiny × glyph with no label.

rule: Bottom sheets on mobile have a grab handle, support swipe-down and a visible close.
check: sheet dismissible by swipe, scrim tap and button
do: Native sheet APIs (presentationDetents, ModalBottomSheet).
dont: Custom sheets that only close by swiping.

rule: Tooltips are supplementary, appear on hover and focus, and can be dismissed with Escape.
check: tooltip shown on focus too; Esc hides it; hoverable (WCAG 1.4.13)
do: aria-describedby to the tooltip; keep it open while hovered.
dont: Critical info only in a title attribute.

rule: Popovers and menus position themselves within the viewport and flip when there is no room.
check: no popover overflows the viewport at 320 px width
do: Use the Popover API with CSS anchor positioning or Floating UI collision handling.
dont: Absolutely positioned menus that run off-screen.

rule: Cookie and consent banners never cover primary content or focus, and reject is as easy as accept.
check: banner height <= 30% of a 375x667 viewport; reject button equal prominence
do: A compact bottom bar with equally sized Accept/Reject.
dont: A full-screen wall with a hidden reject link.

rule: Stacked overlays are avoided; never open a modal from a modal.
check: max one modal layer at a time
do: Replace the dialog content (step 2) instead of stacking.
dont: Confirm dialog on top of an edit dialog on top of a drawer.

rule: Data tables use real table markup with header cells and scope.
check: <table> with <th scope> for row/column headers and a <caption>
do: <caption>, <th scope=col>, <th scope=row>.
dont: Div grids that look like tables.

rule: Right-align numbers and use tabular figures so digits line up.
check: numeric columns right-aligned with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums
do: td.num{text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
dont: Centred, proportional figures in money columns.

rule: Wide tables scroll inside a labelled, focusable region rather than breaking the page.
check: no page-level horizontal overflow at 320 px; scroll container focusable with a name
do: <div role="region" aria-label="Orders" tabindex="0" style="overflow-x:auto">
dont: Letting the table widen the whole page.

rule: Sortable columns are buttons in the header and expose aria-sort.
check: sortable <th> contains a button; active column has aria-sort
do: <th aria-sort="ascending"><button>Date</button></th>
dont: Clickable header text with no state.

rule: Freeze the header row and the identifying first column on long or wide tables.
check: header stays visible after scrolling 3+ rows
do: position:sticky on thead th and first column cells.
dont: Users scrolling 200 rows with no idea which column is which.

rule: On narrow screens, reflow rows into cards only when columns are few; otherwise prioritise columns.
check: at 375 px every row's key fields readable without horizontal page scroll
do: Card rows for <= 5 fields; column priority + 'more' for larger sets.
dont: Squeezing 12 columns into 375 px.

rule: Bulk selection shows the count and the available actions, and selection survives pagination only when stated.
check: selected count visible; 'select all N' explicit
do: '12 selected · Select all 340' with a sticky action bar.
dont: A header checkbox that silently selects only the visible page.

rule: Zebra stripes or row dividers keep a contrast of at least 1.1:1 so rows are trackable but quiet.
check: row separator visible in both themes
do: 1px divider or subtle stripe from tokens.
dont: Heavy borders on every cell.

rule: Truncated cell text is available in full on focus or via a details view.
check: truncated cells expose the full value (title, tooltip or expand)
do: Ellipsis plus a tooltip reachable by keyboard.
dont: Cut-off IDs with no way to read them.

rule: Inline editing makes edit mode obvious and saves or cancels explicitly.
check: Enter saves, Escape cancels, focus returns to the cell
do: Show an input with Save/Cancel; announce the result.
dont: Edits that save on blur with no indication.

rule: Search inputs use type=search inside a role=search landmark with a visible label or button.
check: search form has role=search and a labelled input
do: <form role="search"><label for="q">Search</label><input id="q" type="search">
dont: A bare text input with a magnifier image.

rule: Debounce as-you-type search about 150–300 ms and cancel stale requests.
check: debounce 150-300 ms; earlier responses never overwrite newer ones
do: AbortController per keystroke cycle.
dont: A request per keystroke with out-of-order results.

rule: Show the query and result count, and keep the query in the URL.
check: results page shows count and query; ?q= present in URL
do: '24 results for “linen shirt”'.
dont: Results with no echo of what was searched.

rule: Zero-result pages suggest spelling fixes, broader terms or popular items.
check: no-results view offers at least one recovery path
do: 'No results for “lnen”. Did you mean linen?'
dont: '0 results.' and nothing else.

rule: Autocomplete is a combobox with arrow-key navigation and announced counts.
check: role=combobox, aria-expanded, aria-activedescendant; Up/Down/Enter/Esc work
do: Follow the ARIA combobox pattern or a tested headless library.
dont: A div list under the input that only works with a mouse.

rule: Filters show what is applied and can be cleared individually and all at once.
check: applied filters visible as removable chips + 'Clear all'
do: Chips with an × button labelled 'Remove filter: Blue'.
dont: Filters hidden inside a closed panel with no summary.

rule: Highlight the matched terms in results using <mark>.
check: matched substrings wrapped in <mark>
do: <mark> with a token colour readable in both themes.
dont: Bold-only highlights that disappear in dark mode.

rule: Provide a keyboard shortcut to focus search on content-heavy apps, and show it.
check: '/' or Ctrl/Cmd+K focuses search; hint visible
do: Show '/' hint in the input; skip the shortcut while typing in other fields.
dont: A hidden shortcut that hijacks typing.

rule: Recent and suggested searches are clearable and private by default.
check: recent searches deletable individually
do: A 'Clear' button and per-item remove.
dont: Recent searches that cannot be removed on shared devices.

rule: Search works with typos, plurals and synonyms for the domain.
check: query 'shirts' matches 'shirt'; one-letter typo still returns results
do: Stemming and fuzzy match on the index.
dont: Exact-string LIKE matching only.

rule: Let people try the product before asking for an account when possible.
check: core value reachable before signup in at most 3 steps
do: Guest checkout; sandbox project; demo data.
dont: A signup wall before any content.

rule: Ask for permissions in context, right when the feature needs them, with a reason first.
check: no permission prompt on launch; pre-prompt explains the benefit
do: 'Allow location to show nearby stores' then the system prompt.
dont: Location, notifications and camera prompts on first launch.

rule: Onboarding tours are short (3–5 steps), skippable and replayable.
check: <= 5 steps; 'Skip' on every step; reachable later from help
do: Progress dots, Skip, and 'Replay tour' in Help.
dont: Ten forced coach marks.

rule: Use progressive disclosure: show advanced settings after the basics work.
check: first-run screen shows <= 5 decisions
do: Sensible defaults and an 'Advanced' section.
dont: Twenty settings before the first use.

rule: Multi-step flows show the current step, the total and allow going back without losing data.
check: step indicator 'n of N'; back keeps entered values
do: Stepper with aria-current=step and persisted draft.
dont: A wizard that clears the form on Back.

rule: Checklists for setup show progress and link straight to each task.
check: each checklist item deep-links to its task
do: '3 of 5 done' with direct links.
dont: A static list of instructions.
bad: • Go to settings and find the domain page

rule: Empty first-run screens teach with real sample content, clearly labelled as sample.
check: sample data marked 'Sample' and removable in one action
do: A sample project with a 'Remove sample data' button.
dont: Fake data indistinguishable from real data.
bad: /* demo rows mixed with real rows */

rule: Signup asks only for what is needed now; collect profile details later.
check: signup form <= 3 required fields
do: Email + password (or passkey); everything else later.
dont: Phone, company size and job title on signup.

rule: Offer passkeys and social sign-in alongside email; never force a single provider.
check: at least one non-password option; email fallback
do: Passkey button + email magic link.
dont: Only 'Sign in with X'.

rule: Welcome messages state the single next action, not a feature list.
check: one primary CTA on the welcome screen
do: 'Create your first board' as the one button.
dont: Three equal CTAs and a feature carousel.

rule: Set the document language and mark inline language changes.
check: <html lang> set; foreign phrases have lang attributes
do: <html lang="de"> and <span lang="fr">
dont: No lang, so screen readers mispronounce everything.

rule: Use CSS logical properties so layouts mirror correctly in RTL.
check: no physical left/right margins or padding in component CSS
do: margin-inline-start, padding-inline, inset-inline-end.
dont: margin-left for spacing next to icons.

hook.message: physical left/right spacing; prefer logical properties

rule: Mirror directional icons in RTL but not universal ones.
check: arrows/chevrons flip in dir=rtl; play, clock and checkmarks do not
do: [dir=rtl] .icon-dir{transform:scaleX(-1)}
dont: Flip every icon, including logos and media controls.

rule: Leave room for text expansion of 30–40% and never fix widths on labels.
check: UI survives +40% string length without clipping (pseudo-locale test)
do: Flexible buttons; test with a pseudo-locale.
dont: Fixed-width buttons sized for English.

rule: Format dates, numbers, currency and plurals with the locale APIs.
check: no hand-built date or number strings; Intl/ICU used
do: Intl.DateTimeFormat, Intl.NumberFormat, Intl.PluralRules or ICU messages.
dont: `${n} item(s)` and MM/DD/YYYY everywhere.

rule: Never build sentences by concatenating translated fragments.
check: full sentences with placeholders per message
do: One message per sentence with named placeholders and plural rules.
dont: Glue translated fragments together with variables in between.

rule: Choose fonts that cover every supported script, with sensible fallbacks.
check: no tofu glyphs for supported locales
do: A font stack with script-specific fallbacks (e.g. Noto families).
dont: A Latin-only webfont for an Arabic UI.

rule: Line height and font size are tuned per script (CJK, Arabic, Thai need different metrics).
check: per-locale typography overrides exist for non-Latin scripts
do: :lang(ja){line-height:1.8} :lang(ar){font-size:1.05em}
dont: One line-height for every script.

rule: Let users pick their language explicitly and remember it; do not rely only on IP.
check: language switcher in header or footer; choice persisted
do: A switcher listing languages in their own names (Deutsch, 日本語).
dont: Flags for languages, or forced geo-redirects.

rule: Use bidi isolation for user-generated text inside RTL or LTR strings.
check: user names/values wrapped in <bdi> or dir=auto
do: <bdi> around usernames in mixed-direction sentences.
dont: Raw insertion that scrambles punctuation.

rule: Touch targets are at least 44×44 pt (iOS), 48×48 dp (Android), and never under 24×24 CSS px on web.
check: target box >= 24x24 CSS px with spacing (WCAG 2.5.8); >= 44px recommended for primary actions
do: Pad small icons to a 44 px hit area.
dont: 16 px icon buttons placed edge to edge.

rule: Leave at least 8 px between adjacent targets.
check: gap between interactive targets >= 8 px
do: gap:.5rem between chips and toolbar buttons.
dont: Links stacked with no spacing.

rule: Never disable pinch zoom.
check: viewport meta has no user-scalable=no and no maximum-scale < 2
do: Keep the standard viewport meta and fix layouts that break when zoomed.
dont: maximum-scale=1 or user-scalable=no to stop iOS input zoom.

rule: Inputs use at least 16 px text on mobile web so iOS does not auto-zoom.
check: computed font-size of inputs >= 16 px at 375 px width
do: font-size:max(16px,1rem) on inputs.
dont: 14 px inputs that zoom the page on focus.

rule: Use dynamic viewport units for full-height mobile layouts.
check: full-height sections use dvh/svh with a vh fallback
do: min-height:100svh (or dvh for app shells).
dont: height:100vh, which hides content under mobile browser bars.

rule: Respect safe areas on notched devices.
check: fixed bars use env(safe-area-inset-*) padding; viewport-fit=cover only with it
do: padding-bottom:max(1rem, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)).
dont: A bottom bar hidden behind the home indicator.

rule: Every gesture has a visible, tappable alternative.
check: swipe/long-press/pinch actions also available via buttons or menus
do: Swipe to delete plus a Delete item in the row menu.
dont: Actions that exist only behind swipes.

rule: Put primary actions in the thumb zone on phones.
check: primary action within the bottom 40% of a 375x812 viewport on key mobile flows
do: A sticky bottom CTA on checkout.
dont: The only Continue button at the top-right corner.

rule: Do not rely on hover or right-click on touch devices.
check: @media (hover:none) states expose the same controls
do: Long-press menus with visible '…' buttons.
dont: Tooltips as the only source of help on phones.

rule: Support both orientations unless a single one is essential.
check: content usable in portrait and landscape (WCAG 1.3.4)
do: Responsive layouts that adapt to landscape.
dont: Locking a form to portrait.

rule: Remove the 300 ms tap delay and the grey tap flash with modern CSS, not hacks.
check: touch-action:manipulation on controls; tap highlight styled
do: touch-action:manipulation; -webkit-tap-highlight-color set to a token.
dont: FastClick-era libraries.

rule: Largest Contentful Paint is 2.5 s or less at the 75th percentile.
check: LCP <= 2.5 s (lab on throttled mobile, field p75 reported separately)
do: Preload the hero image, fetchpriority=high, server-render the hero text.
dont: A client-rendered hero that waits for JS.

rule: Interaction to Next Paint is 200 ms or less.
check: INP <= 200 ms; no task > 50 ms in input handlers
do: Yield with scheduler.yield() or split work; paint first.
dont: Long synchronous handlers on click.

rule: Cumulative Layout Shift is 0.1 or less.
check: CLS <= 0.1; images/embeds have dimensions or aspect-ratio
do: width/height or aspect-ratio on media; reserve space for ads and banners.
dont: Injecting a banner above content after load.

rule: Lazy-load below-the-fold images and iframes, never the LCP image.
check: offscreen /
do: loading="lazy" decoding="async" on gallery images.
dont: Lazy-loading the hero.

rule: Serve modern image formats at the right size with srcset and sizes.
check: image transfer <= 1.5x the rendered pixel size; AVIF/WebP offered
do: <picture> with AVIF and WebP, srcset widths, accurate sizes.
dont: A 4000 px JPEG scaled down to 400 px.

rule: Web fonts: at most 2 families and 4 files on first load, subset, preloaded, with font-display.
check: <= 4 font files before LCP; font-display swap or optional; WOFF2
do: Variable WOFF2, preload the one above-the-fold file, size-adjusted fallback.
dont: Six weights of two families plus an icon font.

rule: Animate only transform and opacity; never transition 'all'.
check: no transition:all; animated properties limited to transform/opacity/filter
do: transition: transform .2s, opacity .2s
dont: transition: all .3s on layout-heavy components.

rule: Ship 170 KB or less of compressed JavaScript for a content page's first load.
check: initial JS <= 170 KB gzip for content pages; route-split the rest
do: Server components, islands, dynamic import for heavy widgets.
dont: A 900 KB bundle to render a blog post.

rule: Render long lists with virtualization above about 200 rows.
check: DOM node count < 1500 for list views
do: A windowing library or content-visibility:auto for long static lists.
dont: Mounting 5,000 rows at once.

rule: Load third-party scripts after interaction or idle, with async/defer.
check: no render-blocking third-party <script> in <head>
do: defer analytics; facade for chat widgets and video embeds.
dont: Synchronous tag managers in the head.

rule: Autoplaying background video is muted, inline, short, has a poster and pauses under reduced motion.
check: autoplay video has muted, playsinline, poster; paused for reduced motion; pause control
do: muted playsinline poster plus a pause button.
dont: Autoplay with sound or no pause control.

rule: Respect data-saver and slow connections.
check: heavy media skipped when Save-Data or prefers-reduced-data is set
do: Serve posters instead of video when navigator.connection.saveData is true.
dont: Always stream the hero video.

rule: Body text contrast is at least 4.5:1; large text (24 px, or 18.66 px bold) at least 3:1.
check: text contrast >= 4.5:1 (>= 3:1 large)
do: Check every token pairing in light and dark themes.
dont: Grey #999 text on white.

rule: Non-text UI (borders of inputs, icons that carry meaning, chart marks) contrasts at least 3:1.
check: UI component and graphic contrast >= 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11)
do: Input borders at 3:1 against the background.
dont: Hairline #eee input borders on white.

rule: Use semantic landmarks: one main, plus header, nav and footer.
check: exactly one <main>; header/nav/footer landmarks present
do: <header>, <nav>, <main>, <footer>.
dont: A page built entirely from divs.

rule: Headings form an outline: one h1, no skipped levels for structure.
check: single <h1>; heading levels never jump by more than 1
do: Style with classes; choose levels by structure.
dont: Pick h4 because it looks small.

rule: Images have alt text that conveys purpose; decorative images use empty alt.
check: every has alt; decorative alt=""
do: alt describes the information, not 'image of'.
dont: alt="image" or filenames as alt.

rule: Icon-only buttons have an accessible name and the icon is hidden from assistive tech.
check: icon buttons have aria-label or visually-hidden text; svg aria-hidden=true
do: <button aria-label="Search"><svg aria-hidden="true">
dont: An unlabelled button with only an SVG.

rule: All functionality works with a keyboard alone, in a logical order, with no traps.
check: every control reachable and operable via Tab/Shift+Tab/Enter/Space/Esc
do: Use native elements; add key handlers for custom widgets per ARIA patterns.
dont: Clickable divs and spans.

hook.message: click handler on a non-interactive element

rule: Honour prefers-reduced-motion: remove parallax, autoplay and large movement; keep fades short.
check: with reduce, no transform-based motion > 0 px and no autoplay
do: Wrap motion in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference).
dont: Parallax that ignores the setting.

rule: Nothing flashes more than 3 times per second.
check: no element flashes > 3 Hz
do: Static or slow fades for alerts.
dont: Strobing 'live' badges.

rule: Content reflows at 320 CSS px width and 400% zoom without two-dimensional scrolling.
check: no horizontal scroll at 320 px for text content (WCAG 1.4.10)
do: Fluid layouts, min() widths, wrapping flex rows.
dont: Fixed 1200 px containers.

rule: Text spacing can be increased (line-height 1.5, letter 0.12em, word 0.16em) without clipping.
check: no clipped text under WCAG 1.4.12 spacing overrides
do: Let containers grow with content; avoid fixed heights on text boxes.
dont: Fixed-height cards with overflow:hidden text.

rule: Custom widgets follow the ARIA Authoring Practices pattern or are replaced by native elements.
check: tabs/menus/accordions expose correct roles, states and key bindings
do: Native <details>, <select>, <dialog> first; APG patterns for the rest.
dont: role="button" on a div without key handling.

rule: Dragging actions have a single-pointer alternative.
check: every drag operation also doable with clicks or keys (WCAG 2.5.7)
do: Move up/down buttons beside drag handles.
dont: Reorder only by drag.

rule: Screen-reader-only text uses a robust visually-hidden class, not display:none.
check: sr-only class uses clip-path pattern
do: .sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%);white-space:nowrap}
dont: display:none on text meant for screen readers.

rule: Captions for video with speech; transcripts for audio.
check: <video> with speech has a <track kind=captions>
do: WebVTT captions and a transcript link.
dont: Video with auto-captions never reviewed.

rule: Button labels are verbs that say what happens.
check: primary buttons start with a verb; no 'OK', 'Submit', 'Click here'
do: 'Save changes', 'Send invoice', 'Create account'.
dont: 'Submit', 'OK', 'Yes'.

rule: Link text makes sense out of context.
check: no 'click here', 'read more' or 'learn more' without context
do: 'Read the 2026 pricing report'.
dont: Ten 'Learn more' links on one page.

rule: Line length for body text is 45–75 characters.
check: body text max-width between 45ch and 75ch
do: max-width:65ch on prose.
dont: Full-width paragraphs on a 1920 px screen.

rule: Body text is at least 16 px on web and line height 1.4–1.7.
check: body font-size >= 16 px; line-height 1.4-1.7
do: font-size:1rem; line-height:1.55.
dont: 13 px body copy with 1.1 line height.

rule: Write in plain language at about a grade 8 reading level for general audiences.
check: Flesch-Kincaid grade <= 9 for consumer copy
do: Short sentences, common words, active voice.
dont: 'Leverage synergistic onboarding paradigms'.

rule: Use real, specific content in designs; never ship lorem ipsum or placeholder stats.
check: no 'lorem ipsum', 'Your Name', '10x' placeholder copy in shipped files
do: Real product names, real numbers with sources.
dont: 'Lorem ipsum' or invented testimonials.

rule: Keep terminology consistent: one name per concept across the product.
check: glossary terms used consistently (e.g. never both 'project' and 'workspace' for one thing)
do: Keep a short glossary and lint UI strings against it.
dont: 'Delete', 'Remove' and 'Trash' for the same action.

rule: Use sentence case for UI labels and headings unless the brand says otherwise.
check: labels in sentence case
do: 'Create new project'.
dont: 'Create New Project' everywhere, or ALL CAPS paragraphs.

rule: Front-load headings and labels with the words people scan for.
check: first 2 words of each heading carry the key term
do: 'Refunds: how long they take'.
dont: 'Everything you need to know about our refund process'.
bad: A quick note about how we think about refunds

rule: Numbers, dates and units are shown in formats the reader understands, with units.
check: every number has a unit; relative dates have absolute tooltips
do: '2 h ago' with a full timestamp on hover/focus.
dont: '3' with no unit, or '04/05/06'.

rule: Truncation never hides meaning; use line clamping with full text available.
check: clamped text has an expand control or full text on detail view
do: -webkit-line-clamp:3 plus 'Show more'.
dont: Cutting product names mid-word with no way to read them.

rule: Dark themes use dark grey surfaces (about #121212–#1e1e1e) rather than pure black for large areas.
check: large surfaces not #000 unless OLED-specific; text not pure #fff on pure #000
do: Layered surfaces from tokens: --surface-1, --surface-2.
dont: Pure #fff text on #000, which causes halation.

rule: Re-check every contrast pairing in dark mode; do not invert colours mechanically.
check: all text >= 4.5:1 in dark theme
do: Separate dark tokens tuned for contrast.
dont: filter:invert(1) on the page.

rule: Declare color-scheme so native controls, scrollbars and form fields match the theme.
check: color-scheme set on :root (or meta) for light and dark
do: :root{color-scheme:light dark}
dont: Light native date pickers inside a dark UI.

hook.message: dark theme without a color-scheme declaration

rule: Follow the system preference by default and let users override it, persisting their choice.
check: theme toggle offers light/dark/system; choice persists; no flash on load
do: Set data-theme in a blocking inline script before first paint.
dont: Flash of light theme on every load.

rule: Express elevation with lighter surfaces, not heavier shadows, in dark mode.
check: raised surfaces lighter than the base by a token step
do: Card --surface-2 lighter than --surface-1.
dont: Black drop shadows that vanish on dark backgrounds.

rule: Desaturate saturated brand colours for dark backgrounds.
check: accent colours on dark surfaces still >= 3:1 and not vibrating
do: Use a lighter, less saturated tint of the brand colour in dark mode.
dont: Pure #0000ff links on dark grey.

rule: Images and illustrations adapt: provide dark variants or reduce brightness of bright images.
check: logos and diagrams have dark variants or transparent backgrounds
do: <picture> with a prefers-color-scheme source for logos.
dont: White-boxed PNG logos on dark headers.

rule: Charts and status colours have dark-theme versions that keep their meaning and contrast.
check: chart series and status tokens >= 3:1 against dark surface
do: Separate dark palette for data and status.
dont: Reusing light-theme chart colours that disappear on dark.

rule: Shadows, borders and dividers are visible but subtle in both themes.
check: dividers between 1.2:1 and 3:1 against their surface in both themes
do: Theme-specific --line tokens.
dont: Borders that disappear entirely in dark mode.

rule: Test focus rings, selection and highlights in dark mode.
check: focus ring >= 3:1 against dark surfaces; ::selection readable
do: A focus token per theme.
dont: A dark-blue focus ring on a near-black surface.
